verdict.rationale: Bruno's API-client docs explicitly describe pre-request and post-response JavaScript with a `bru` API, request chaining, and library support (bruno-docs-31). The script editors appear on Pre-Request and Post-Response tabs at request, folder, and collection level (bruno-docs-37, bruno-docs-38), and the CLI's Developer Mode enables external npm packages and filesystem access (bruno-docs-61). The community fs-module request (bruno-comm-9) confirms pre-request scripting is in use, and Developer Mode appears to address that request. missing for 10: detailed evidence of the `bru` API surface and variable-passing semantics for chaining, independent hands-on corroboration of chaining and data-massaging workflows.
